The hugely talented 19-year-old, who was tipped for the very top when he arrived at Chelsea and showed quality in spades in his debut season at Stamford Bridge, has featured for just 47 minutes across six appearances in the Premier League this season, with Palmer, along with Joao Pedro and Morgan Rogers, firmly blocking his path to the first team.
Can’t wait to hear Mike Dean explain how neither of Palmer’s yellows were straight red cards.

The quirk of the fixture list and the FA handbook has spared Palmer any Premier League absence, but he will sit out Chelsea ’s next game: a daunting trip to Anfield.

After escaping a straight red card for barging into Mateus Fernandes face, Palmer picked up a second yellow for treading on Conor Gallagher's leg, as Xabi Alonso's men slipped to a dreadful 2-0 defeat against their London rivals.
PALMER SUSPENDED… BUT NOT FOR GAMEWEEK 9 Chelsea ended the match with only one of their first-choice attacking trident on the pitch.
Cole Palmer (£9.8m) saw red for two bookable offences, and in truth could have received his marching orders for either incident .

The Blues, who were without top scorer Joao Pedro , had the first chance of the game when Cole Palmer ’s curled effort towards the top corner was tipped behind by Antonin Kinsky , before Mohamed Kudus fired wide from a similar angle at the other end.
Palmer’s dismissal, which came between Spurs’ goals, compounded a miserable day for Xabi Alonso, who suffered his first home defeat as Chelsea boss.
Alonso will regret his inability to deploy an injured Joao Pedro and then rue the lack of attacking prowess well before Cole Palmer was sent off.
After initially appearing on the injury report as limited , Palmer missed Saturday's practice and was ruled out for the game "He got kind of twisted up yesterday in practice.
He scored early against Bournemouth and also rose in price this week, making him a sensible option for managers who cannot stretch to Palmer but still want a route into Chelsea’s front line.
There were doubts about the involvement of Caicedo and Pedro against Bournemouth, while Palmer missed international duty with England due to injury.
In the frontline, Pedro has already scored three times and produced three assists in the top flight, while Palmer has two goals and two assists in the Premier League so far.
Palmer has established himself as a key figure in Chelsea’s attack since arriving from Manchester City for £42.5million in 2023.

Palmer , left ‌out of England 's World Cup squad ‌this year after a persistent groin injury ‌affected his form, was called up ‌by Thomas Tuchel for Nations League fixtures against Spain, the Czech Republic and Croatia.
Tuchel left Palmer at home for the 2026 World Cup, but he decided to call up the Chelsea star for the first four fixtures of the UEFA Nations League.

Cody Gakpo is dealing with an ankle problem, Cole Palmer remains flagged after withdrawing from England, Joao Pedro is still working back from a knee issue and Arsenal have multiple players carrying fitness concerns.

Cole Palmer Injury Update for FPL GW6 Monday, Oct. 5: Playing Through Pain Per Tuchel Cole Palmer withdrew from England duty on Sept. 25, and Tuchel said "my understanding is that he is playing with discomfort and pain." He played the full 90 in Chelsea's 3-0 loss to Brentford.

Joao Pedro leads the attack with Rogers to his left and Palmer his right, but the trio’s fluidity and flexibility allow them to interchange, dragging defenders out of position and creating space for others.

Palmer was outstanding in his first two campaigns at Stamford Bridge, but injury made it difficult for him to replicate that level of performance in 2025/26.
Palmer caught one of three targets for 43 yards with a touchdown in Thursday's 41-31 win over the Lions.
Palmer Palmer remains the better choice when: you need a captain, you value penalties, premium price is not a problem.

reasons.text: It's too simplistic to say that Villa lost Youri Tielemans, Morgan Rogers, Lucas Digne, Emiliano Martinez, Ezri Konsa and Ollie Watkins – the transfer fees those players attracted were vital – but the turnover meant that their recruitment had to be all but perfect just for the club to stand still.

Konsa has been replaced not by new signing Taylor Harwood-Bellis, but by 32-year-old Victor Lindelof He joined the club on a free transfer on deadline day last summer after leaving Manchester United but his acquisition was not a stroke of genius on the part of Emery, previous recruitment head Monchi, or anyone else.

Arsenal corner caused confusion in the box, and after Jordan Pickford and Vitali Mykolenko both failed to clear, Ezri Konsa turned home his first Gunners goal from point-blank range, marking the first time Everton have conceded from a corner this season.
Ezri Konsa’s early goal opened the scoring for the hosts, before Gabriel doubled the lead in the second half.
Goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel Magalhães helped Arsenal to a 2-0 win over Everton , taking them level on points with Manchester City at the top of the Premier League.

In teeming rain at the Emirates Stadium, Arsenal’s centre-backs provided the key moments in front of goal, with Konsa netting for the first time since his arrival from Aston Villa and Gabriel making the points safe midway through the second half.

However, the North London giants belatedly bagged their first corner goal of the campaign to draw first blood against Everton on October 24, as Konsa struck his first Gunners goal at the back stick following an episode of penalty-box pinball.
Konsa opened the scoring inside seven minutes in north London, prodding home from close range after Martin Odegaard's dangerous corner popped up and was clawed on to the crossbar by Jordan Pickford.

It was a period of substantial change for the Villans, who lost Amadou Onana to an ACL injury during the World Cup, Youri Tielemans to Manchester United , Ezri Konsa to Arsenal, Ollie Watkins to Al-Hilal, and Morgan Rogers and Emiliano Martinez to Chelsea .

Dowman is named on the bench for the first team against Leeds, with Mosquera the extra man. — Jeorge Bird (@jeorgebird) October 10, 2026 Really, only when William Saliba (£5.9m) returns – likely in November – will we fear Konsa’s minutes.

Ezri Konsa © Imago / Sportimage Status: Major doubt Type of injury: Thigh Possible return date: October 10 (vs. Leeds) Ezri Konsa left the England camp to have treatment after taking another hit to his quad, and while Thomas Tuchel played down any serious concern, he did not want to risk the defender playing on through the pain.

Konsa started two of England's first three matches in the current international break, playing the full 90 in the 3-2 loss to Spain and 7-0 thumping of Croatia, either side of being an unused substitute in the 2-0 win over Czechia.
KONSA RETURNS TO ARSENAL It’s been a rollercoaster international break for Ezri Konsa (£4.6m) and his owners in Fantasy Premier League (FPL).
Konsa was sidelined ( as a non-playing substitute ) for last Tuesday’s win over Czechia with a muscular niggle.
Konsa was brought to the Emirates Stadium to provide defensive reinforcement following a long-term back injury to star centre-back William Saliba.
Konsa sat out the midweek win over the Czech Republic as an unused substitute due to a minor injury issue.

Arsenal and England fans will be pleased to hear that Konsa is already back in training and should be ready for the fixture in Rijeka. © Iconsport / PA Images England receive Konsa fitness boost Speaking at Friday's press conference, Tuchel said: "It seems that Ezri Konsa is back.

Hill, who came off the bench in the 3-0 win at Old Trafford in 2024/25 and in the 4-4 draw last season, played the full 90 minutes.
James Hill (£5.5m) finished just one point behind on seven for the gameweek.
Ryan Christie (£5.0m) and James Hill (£5.5m) both collected the additional Defensive Contribution points available to outfield players.
Hill also gained an extra two points for his 11 defensive contributions.
